meta.evidence_status: CALCULATION (datasheet values labelled MFR with ledger ids; assumptions labelled)

kfosc.note: two 5-state filters at 2 kHz plus the IMU increment buffer

akf.note: 8 states x 2 axes, shared covariance, rollback history for the delayed page sensor

context.note: 18 joint states; plus a template buffer of about 2000 points (2 letters at 20 um) in int16 pairs would be 8 kB, counted as float here
context.worst_tick_note: above the 500 us tick when rollback_samples is large (120 Hz page sensor): re-apply the stored gains to the state only (about 60 MAC per sample) and update the covariance once per page sample, or run the rollback in a lower-priority thread (proposal, not simulated)

bmflc.note: 23 basis frequencies x (sin, cos) x 2 axes

_assumptions.int8_cmsis_nn: 0.5 MAC/cycle + 300 cycles per layer call (ml/budget.py convention)
_assumptions.label: CALCULATION; ASSUMPTION for the cycle model; to be profiled on the target
